statement: The WiiBrew Wiimote SDP information section distinguishes the Bluetooth identity of older Wii Remotes and earlier Wii Remote Plus units (RVL-CNT-01 with Nintendo product 0x0306) from later Wii Remote Plus -TR units (RVL-CNT-01-TR with product 0x0330). These are documented transport identifiers; they do not independently prove integrated gyro capability from SDP identity alone.

applicability.revision: WiiBrew community documented Wii Remote family; precise physical hardware variant not independently captured
applicability.scope: WiiBrew oldid 123257 section SDP information; pinned kernel hid-wiimote-core.c lines 809-865 maps names to generations. Corroborates the name-classification issue while retaining early hardware-specific unknowns.
